points.left: Grief is answered with resurrection and gathering. 1 Thessalonians 4:13–18 belongs to Communities, suffering, and final charge.

points.label: Deception, rebellion, and comfort
points.left: Grief is answered with resurrection and gathering. But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, about those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope. Therefore comfort one another with these words.
points.right: Gathering, rebellion, and the remembered warning. Now, brothers, about the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?
